paragraphs: A Jaguar AJ133 (AJ-V8 Gen III) engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Jaguar already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ133 (AJ-V8 Gen III) owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six AJ133 (AJ-V8 Gen III)-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Jaguar AJ133 engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ133 — also known as the AJ-V8 Gen III — is Jaguar Land Rover's 5.0-litre V8 petrol engine, produced from 2009 to 2024.

faqLeft.q: Which Jaguar models use the AJ133?
faqLeft.a: F-Pace SVR, F-Type R/SVR, XE Project 8, XF XFR/XFR-S, XJ Supersport/XJR and XK XKR/XKR-S.

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ133 differ between Jaguar models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same.

faqLeft.q: Is an AJ133 from one Jaguar model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A supercharged AJ133 from an F-Pace SVR isn't a drop-in match for a naturally aspirated AJ133 from an earlier XJ — ancillaries, mounting, ECU calibration, and supercharger tune all differ.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar AJ133 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £5,500 for the supercharged V8, regardless of which model it's fitted to.
Yes. We work on AJ133 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you work on AJ133 naturally aspirated engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. Naturally aspirated AJ133 applications (XF, XJ, XK, 385-470 hp) are within our workshop capability.

faqRight.q: Do you work on AJ133S SVR engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. AJ133S high-output applications (F-Pace SVR, XFR-S, XKR-S, 550-575 hp) are within our workshop capability.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Jaguar AJ133 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Jaguar if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ133 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ133 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
